caption: The drawing depicts two similarly styled bodices, each with fitted three-quarter length sleeves and angular peplum detailing at the waist. The bodice at the top is peach in color, with subtle shading to suggest folds in the fabric and accented with a cuff featuring three round decorations on each sleeve. The lower bodice is colored in a light blue, also shaded to indicate textile texture, and includes the same peplum and sleeve cuff design. Both garments have a square neckline and panel seams down the front. The illustration is outlined in black ink, and the items are displayed against an unadorned off-white background. At the bottom of the page, there is a pink writing with the note “H-11-a” and the name “LILLIAN CAUSEY” appears in small printed capitals in the lower right corner.
title: Satin Bodice
